title: Faraday disc: EMF vs rotation speed
description: Ramp the drive on the homopolar disc and plot its EMF against RPM. For a disc of radius r in an axial field B, EMF = ½·B·ω·r², a straight line through the origin with slope ½·B·r²·2π/60 per RPM (≈ 5.64e-4 V/RPM for the bench's 0.55 T, 0.14 m disc). The disc drives its own current through an 8 mΩ loop, which brakes it hard: full drive settles near 54 RPM, so the ramp spans roughly 5–54 RPM. Simulated, not metrology.
